services.name: Kayaking Camps
services.desc: This summer get your child out on the water at an Ottawa New Edinburgh (ONEC) Kayaking Summer Day Camps (with Voyageur Canoeing and Stand-up Paddleboarding)! Kids will have fun learning a new sport (or improve on the skills learned last year), discover the amazing Ottawa River, and make new friends! Day campers are taught by Paddle Canada certified camp counsellors. Paddle into summer excitement-join ONEC’s kayaking camps for a season of adventure! services.name: Sail Canada
services.desc: ONEC operates a sailing camp for youth between the ages of 9 and 17. The students receive quality instruction stressing safety, fun, and learning. They are introduced to many different elements of sailing, safety practices, and seamanship. They will develop new skills in boat handling and sailing for both fun and competition. If you book multiple weeks of camp you are also eligible for an additional 10% discount. We're working on expanding our galleries to give kids & parents an idea of what we have on offer at our camps! services.name: Tennis Camps
services.desc: Every camper learns stroke basics, game strategy, footwork, sportsmanship and receives an ONEC day camp tshirt. The camp is run in a safe and structured environment by responsible and mature tennis instructors. ​ONEC’s day camps are a great way to get your child interested in tennis or to build on the skills they already possess.
